## Research Experience

### Independent Research, Re-reading the ACC Bibliography

[Sep 2026 – Oct 2026]{.meta}

- Rebuilt the 2020 study below on the 2019 and 2026 editions of Paul R. Goldin’s *Ancient Chinese Civilization: Bibliography of Materials in Western Languages* (12,214 and 16,928 entries).
- Structured datasets for both editions through AI-assisted entry-by-entry verification with adjudication of disputed entries.
- Measured decade-to-decade change in title meaning with multilingual sentence embeddings; part of the apparent 1970s shift traced to the change from Wade-Giles to pinyin romanization.
- Published aggregate results with the compiler’s permission: [Re-reading the ACC bibliography](research/acc-bibliometrics.html).

### Master’s Thesis, Harvard University

[Advisors: Sun Joo Kim, Si Nae Park · Mar 2024]{.meta}

“The In-Between Place of Sŏŏl (庶孼) in the Society and Diplomacy of Chosŏn Korea.”

- Analyzed Korean, Japanese, Chinese, and English sources to connect status discrimination in Chosŏn Korea with how secondary-status members of the 1763 mission to Tokugawa Japan engaged Japanese scholars and presented that contact to readers at home.

### Honors Thesis, University of Pennsylvania

[Advisors: Siyen Fei, Kathy Peiss · Mar 2022]{.meta}

“To Be or Not to Be Korean in Japan: Questions of Nationality and Personal Identity of Joseon Korean War Slaves, 1592–1598.”

- Examined identity formation among Korean war captives during and after internment in Japan, reading popular accounts against state-issued moral instruction.

### Independent Research, University of Pennsylvania

[Advisor: Paul R. Goldin · Aug 2020]{.meta}

“A Study on the Evolution of Chinese Studies, 1800–2019.” Unpublished.

- Converted a major bibliography into a structured dataset and used Excel and basic natural-language processing in Python to analyze research trends in Chinese studies, 1800–2019.

### Research Assistant, University of Pennsylvania

[Advisor: Paul R. Goldin · Aug 2019]{.meta}

- Traced articles, authors, and publication years through journal databases to repair mis-transcribed records in a major Western-language bibliography.
